dialogue.text: He was one of those guy retiring types on the outside, but nothing could be further from the truth.
dialogue.zh: 他表面上看起來像是那種即將退休的人，但事實完全不是這樣。
dialogue.ja: 彼は外見上は引退間近の男の一人のように見えましたが、実際は全く違いました。
dialogue.local: He was one of those guy retiring types on the outside, but nothing could be further from the truth.
dialogue.en: He was one of those guy retiring types on the outside, but nothing could be further from the truth.

dialogue.text: He had a calling for this mountain. It was a special mountain for him that he had to play.
dialogue.zh: 他對這座山有一種使命感。這座山對他來說很特別，他必須征服它。
dialogue.ja: 彼にはこの山に対する使命感がありました。この山は彼にとって特別なもので、挑まなければならなかったのです。
dialogue.local: He had a calling for this mountain. It was a special mountain for him that he had to play.
dialogue.en: He had a calling for this mountain. It was a special mountain for him that he had to play.

dialogue.text: When I was crossing into a vassalage, number I stayed away, which I was standing.
dialogue.zh: 當我穿越一個屬地時，我保持距離，站在一旁。
dialogue.ja: 私が属領に入るとき、距離を置いて立っていました。
dialogue.local: When I was crossing into a vassalage, number I stayed away, which I was standing.
dialogue.en: When I was crossing into a vassalage, number I stayed away, which I was standing.

dialogue.text: I was tensing he was following, had the right height and a very short time, and pulled me upside into a very far.
dialogue.zh: 我感到緊張，他跟隨著，達到了合適的高度，在很短的時間內把我拉向一個很遠的地方。
dialogue.ja: 私は緊張していました。彼は後を追い、適切な高さに達し、短時間で私を遠くへ引き上げました。
dialogue.local: I was tensing he was following, had the right height and a very short time, and pulled me upside into a very far.
dialogue.en: I was tensing he was following, had the right height and a very short time, and pulled me upside into a very far.

dialogue.text: He said he was out in front, cutting these steps, great sheets of snow and ice, breaking loose and just taking off down the steep slope.
dialogue.zh: 他說他在前面開路，切出階梯，大片的雪和冰塊鬆動，然後就順著陡坡滑了下去。
dialogue.ja: 彼は先頭に立ち、階段を切り開いていました。大きな雪と氷の塊が崩れ、急な斜面を滑り落ちていきました。
dialogue.local: He said he was out in front, cutting these steps, great sheets of snow and ice, breaking loose and just taking off down the steep slope.
dialogue.en: He said he was out in front, cutting these steps, great sheets of snow and ice, breaking loose and just taking off down the steep slope.

dialogue.text: He started having some doubts, whether it was safe to go on and the little voice within him spoke up and it was Ed Maboy.
dialogue.zh: 他開始有些懷疑，是否繼續前進是安全的，內心的小聲音響起，那是艾德·馬博伊。
dialogue.ja: 彼は先に進むのが安全かどうか疑い始めましたが、心の中の小さな声が聞こえました。それはエド・マボイでした。
dialogue.local: He started having some doubts, whether it was safe to go on and the little voice within him spoke up and it was Ed Maboy.
dialogue.en: He started having some doubts, whether it was safe to go on and the little voice within him spoke up and it was Ed Maboy.

dialogue.text: This is Everest. Sometimes you've got to be prepared to push it a lot harder, and he looked down at tensing and they both smiled at each other and nodded and they kept on going.
dialogue.zh: 這是珠穆朗瑪峰。有時你必須準備好更加努力，他看著緊張的隊友，兩人相視微笑點頭，繼續前進。
dialogue.ja: ここはエベレストです。時にはもっと頑張る覚悟が必要です。彼はテンシングを見下ろし、二人は笑い合い、うなずいて進み続けました。
dialogue.local: This is Everest. Sometimes you've got to be prepared to push it a lot harder, and he looked down at tensing and they both smiled at each other and nodded and they kept on going.
dialogue.en: This is Everest. Sometimes you've got to be prepared to push it a lot harder, and he looked down at tensing and they both smiled at each other and nodded and they kept on going.

dialogue.text: Tensing who can speak no English is asked his reaction as to his magnificent achievement.
dialogue.zh: 不會說英語的緊張被問及對他偉大成就的反應。
dialogue.ja: 英語が話せないテンシングに、彼の素晴らしい達成についての感想を尋ねました。
dialogue.local: Tensing who can speak no English is asked his reaction as to his magnificent achievement.
dialogue.en: Tensing who can speak no English is asked his reaction as to his magnificent achievement.

dialogue.text: I think what he wanted. He's very happy.
dialogue.zh: 我想他得到了他想要的。他非常高興。
dialogue.ja: 彼は望んでいたことを成し遂げたと思います。彼はとても幸せそうです。
dialogue.local: I think what he wanted. He's very happy.
dialogue.en: I think what he wanted. He's very happy.

dialogue.text: 5,000 Indians clam around the aircraft to catch a glimpse of the two who reached the summit.
dialogue.zh: 五千名印度人圍繞飛機，想要一睹兩位登頂者的風采。
dialogue.ja: 5000人のインド人が飛行機の周りに群がり、頂上に到達した二人を一目見ようとしました。
dialogue.local: 5,000 Indians clam around the aircraft to catch a glimpse of the two who reached the summit.
dialogue.en: 5,000 Indians clam around the aircraft to catch a glimpse of the two who reached the summit.

dialogue.text: The shock when all of a sudden messages started coming in, congratulations from Prime Ministers and all sorts of other people.
dialogue.zh: 突然間，來自總理和各方人士的祝賀訊息湧入，令人震驚。
dialogue.ja: 突然、首相やさまざまな人々からの祝福のメッセージが届き、驚きました。
dialogue.local: The shock when all of a sudden messages started coming in, congratulations from Prime Ministers and all sorts of other people.
dialogue.en: The shock when all of a sudden messages started coming in, congratulations from Prime Ministers and all sorts of other people.

dialogue.text: She was a hope for millions of people around the world. In India he was worshipped by the people.
dialogue.zh: 她是全世界數百萬人的希望。在印度，他被人民崇拜。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は世界中の何百万人もの人々の希望でした。インドでは彼は人々に崇拝されていました。
dialogue.local: She was a hope for millions of people around the world. In India he was worshipped by the people.
dialogue.en: She was a hope for millions of people around the world. In India he was worshipped by the people.

dialogue.text: Building schools and hospitals. He was an incredible man and he was an amazing father.
dialogue.zh: 他建造學校和醫院。他是個了不起的人，也是個了不起的父親。
dialogue.ja: 学校や病院を建てました。彼は素晴らしい人物であり、素晴らしい父親でもありました。
dialogue.local: Building schools and hospitals. He was an incredible man and he was an amazing father.
dialogue.en: Building schools and hospitals. He was an incredible man and he was an amazing father.

dialogue.text: The true joy him to him after climbing Everest was giving back to the people that lived in the Himalayas.
dialogue.zh: 他登上珠穆朗瑪峰後真正的喜悅，是回饋生活在喜馬拉雅山的人們。
dialogue.ja: エベレスト登頂後の彼の本当の喜びは、ヒマラヤに住む人々に恩返しをすることでした。
dialogue.local: The true joy him to him after climbing Everest was giving back to the people that lived in the Himalayas.
dialogue.en: The true joy him to him after climbing Everest was giving back to the people that lived in the Himalayas.
